items.topic: AT&T Q3 2026 results and stock reaction
items.facts: AT&T beat Q3 estimates and raised 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to ~$2.40 (from $2.25-2.35); added 379,000 postpaid phone subscribers vs ~379,300 expected, down from 432,000 prior quarter; stock fell ~6% (worst performer in S&P 500 that session); commentary cites SpaceX Starlink Mobile competition; Verizon -2.48%, T-Mobile -3% same day.
items.caveat: Minor cross-source variance on exact close (-5.9% to -6.23% reported across outlets vs this system's own close of -6.45% to $21.91); this system's own script-verified close is used for magnitude, press cited only for stated reason, per §4C.

items.topic: Netflix Q3 2026 results and stock reaction
items.facts: Q3 EPS $0.87 beat estimates (vs $0.59 Q3'25); revenue $12.87B +12% y/y, in line; cut 2026 ad-revenue forecast to $2.7B from $3B citing slower ad-product rollout; guided Q4 EPS $0.67 vs ~$0.73 consensus; stock closed -5.3% to $65.04, a two-year low.
items.caveat: This system's own close (-5.31% to $65.04) matches Yahoo Finance reporting almost exactly.
